info.name: Nonmus Monolith
info.description:
Nonmus full-stack video/social platform backend.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:8080)

Auth: JWT is stored in httpOnly cookies (`access_token` 60min, `refresh_token` 7d/30d).
Sign up/log in once, then Postman's cookie jar keeps you authenticated.

Public endpoints: POST /auth/**, GET /email/verify, POST /forgot-password/**.
Everything else requires an authenticated session. `/users/me` returns user info;
on a 401 the frontend calls POST /auth/refresh.

request.description:
Creates a new account and sets JWT cookies in the response.

Body:
- name: string (required)
- email: string (required, unique)
- password: string (required)

On success the `access_token` and `refresh_token` cookies are stored by Postman automatically.

Authenticates and sets JWT cookies.

Body:
- email: string (required)
- password: string (required)
- rememberMe: boolean — `true` issues a 30-day refresh token, `false` a 7-day token.

Run this before calling authenticated endpoints so the cookie jar is populated.

Rotates the access token using the `refresh_token` cookie. No body needed.

Reads the refresh cookie from the request, validates it, and issues a fresh `access_token` cookie. Call this when an authenticated request returns 401.
Clears the JWT cookies (expires them) and revokes server state. No body needed.

Public. Confirms an email address using the token from the emailed verification link.

Query: token (string, required). Returns `{ message: 'Verification Successful' }`.
Authenticated. Sends a new verification link to the logged-in user's email. No body needed — the user is resolved from the session.

Public. Requests a verification code be emailed to the given address.

Body: { email }. Returns `{ message: 'Verification code sent to your email' }`.

Public. Validates the emailed code and returns a `reset_token` cookie (10-min expiry) used by the next step.

Body: { email, code }.

Public. Sets a new password. Requires the `reset_token` cookie from the Verify step (cookie jar auto-sends it). Clears the cookie afterwards.

Body: { newPassword }. Returns 204 No Content.

Creates a user directly (service-level, does not set cookies).

Body: { name, email, password }. Returns the created user.
Authenticated. Returns the current user's profile (resolved from the session cookie).

Authenticated. Updates the logged-in user's profile.

Body: { name } (currently the only updatable field). Returns the updated user.

item.name: Profile Picture (S3 Presigned Upload)

request.description:
Authenticated — Step 1 of 3.

Body:
- contentType: allowed values image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif
- fileSize: bytes; max 5242880 (5 MB)

Returns `presignedUrl`, `s3Key`, `expiresInSeconds`. The test script auto-saves `presignedUploadUrl` and `s3Key` for the next steps.

header.description: Must match the contentType sent in Step 1

request.description:
Step 2 — uploads the file directly to S3; the backend is NOT involved.

- URL is the `presignedUploadUrl` saved from Step 1 (S3 instance, e.g. http://localhost:4566)
- Body: set to binary and pick an image file
- NO Authorization header (the presign query params are the auth)
- Content-Type header must match Step 1 exactly

Expected: 200/204 empty body from S3.

Authenticated — Step 3.

Body: { s3Key } (auto-populated from Step 1).

Backend validates the key belongs to you (prefix check), deletes your old picture, saves the new key, and returns a fresh presigned GET `viewUrl`.

Authenticated. Returns a fresh presigned GET URL for the current user's profile picture.

Call on page load and when the previous URL expires (onerror handler). If no picture is set, returns `{ viewUrl: '', expiresInSeconds: 0 }`.

item.description:
3-step presigned URL upload flow.

1. Run [1] → presignedUploadUrl + s3Key auto-saved
2. Run [2] → upload file directly to S3 (backend not involved)
3. Run [3] → backend saves the key and returns a presigned view URL

request.description:
Authenticated. Creates a channel owned by the logged-in user.

Body:
- name: string (required)
- description: string
- type: PRIVATE | PUBLIC
- handle: string — unique channel handle

Returns 201 with the created channel.

Authenticated. Fetches a channel by its UUID.

Path: channelId (UUID).

Authenticated. Fetches a channel by its handle.

Path: handle (string).

Authenticated. Lists channels the current user subscribes to, with cursor pagination.

Query:
- cursor: opaque token from the previous response's `nextCursor` (optional)
- limit: page size, clamped to 1–50 (default 20)

Returns `{ channels, nextCursor, hasNext }`.

Checks whether a channel handle is available.

Path: handle (string). Returns `{ isAvailable: boolean }`.

Authenticated. Generates a presigned PUT URL for a channel logo upload.

Body:
- contentType: allowed image types (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif)
- fileSize: bytes, max 5 MB

Returns `presignedUrl`, `s3Key`, `expiresInSeconds`.

Authenticated. Creates an invite link for a channel.

Body:
- channelId: UUID (required)
- expiry: ISO-8601 instant
- maxUses: number of allowed joins
- joinType: ANYONE | PASSWORD | APPROVAL
- password: required when joinType is PASSWORD

Returns 201 with inviteId, channelId, token, expiry, maxUses, currentUses, joinType. The test script auto-saves `inviteToken` and `inviteId` for the Get Invite Info request.

response.name: 400 Bad Request (Password required)

request.description:
Public. Resolves an invite token and returns channel + invite metadata so a visitor can preview the channel before joining.

Path: inviteToken (string, auto-saved from Create Channel Invite).

Returns inviteId, channelId, channelName, channelLogo, joinType, expiry, currentUses, maxUses.

Errors: 400 INVALID_INVITE if the token is unknown, expired, or at max uses.

response.name: 400 Bad Request (Max uses reached)

request.description:
Authenticated. Joins a channel using an invite token.

Path: inviteToken (string, auto-saved from Create Channel Invite).

Body:
- password: string — required only when the invite's joinType is PASSWORD; omit/null otherwise

Returns channelId, channelName, channelLogo, role (MEMBER), joinedAt.

Errors: 400 INVALID_INVITE if the token is unknown/expired/at max uses or the password is wrong; 409 USER_ALREADY_IN_CHANNEL if the user is already a member.

response.name: 409 Conflict (Already a member)
400 Bad Request (APPROVAL not supported)

request.description:
Owner-only. Updates an existing invite.

Path: inviteId (UUID, auto-saved from Create Channel Invite).

Body (all optional, only provided fields are changed):
- expiry: ISO-8601 instant
- maxUses: number of allowed joins
- joinType: ANYONE | PASSWORD | APPROVAL (password re-hashed; nulled if switching to non-PASSWORD)
- password: required when switching joinType to PASSWORD, or to rotate an existing PASSWORD invite's password

Returns the updated invite (inviteId, channelId, token, expiry, maxUses, currentUses, joinType).

Errors: 403 CHANNEL_ACCESS_DENIED for non-owners; 400 INVALID_INVITE for bad request.

response.name: 400 Bad Request (Password missing for PASSWORD)
